2.211.1
MapColorScale.ActionInfo
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The MapColorScale.ActionInfo element specifies a collection of actions for a map color scale. This
element is optional. This element is of type ActionInfo.
The following is the parent element of the MapColorScale.ActionInfo element.
Parent elements
MapColorScale
The following is the XML Schema definition of the MapColorScale.ActionInfo element.
 <xsd:element name="ActionInfo" type="ActionInfoType" minOccurs="0" />
